commitments.description: World Without Waste: collect and recycle a bottle or can for every one sold by 2030.
Use 50% recycled material in primary packaging by 2030.
Reusable packaging to reach 25% of total servings by 2030.

controversies.description: Ranked #1 plastic polluter in Break Free From Plastic global brand audits every year 2018–2023.
Withdrew from a key 2025 reusable-packaging target in 2024, citing market conditions.

wooby.headline: The biggest brand on every beach Wooby visits.
wooby.narrative: Wooby finds Coca-Cola bottles on more beaches than any other brand. Coca-Cola has promised to use more recycled plastic, but it walked back its reusable-bottle goal. Wooby is waiting to see real progress.

sources.note: Verify the latest signatory progress report.
